mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate relative to historical averages compresses the equity discount rate, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5% (historical median), or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPIAUCSL inflation rate exceeds 3.5%, the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, causing a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%), labor market tightness fuels inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the expansion matures.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals an overheating labor market that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a stagflationary risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors flee equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS increasing by more than 0.5% in 3 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced corporate borrowing.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
